Fix Homepage 'Next' Button Flow
fixes.detail: Browser tests show flow-skipped on Homepage due to no visible Next button, preventing quiz exercise.
fixes.text: Add a minimal HTML/JS snippet to the homepage that renders a 'Next Question' button if any questions are loaded in the DOM context. This requires zero backend changes and fixes the interactive loop immediately.

fixes.fix: Add Retry Logic for Tutor Lane Failures
fixes.detail: The on-demand lane shows 1 failure (tutor-questions) where the model output lacked a JSON array, causing the pipeline to stop.
fixes.text: Modify the local Node script handling 'owner-on-demand' to wrap Ollama calls in a retry loop with a simple regex fallback if the JSON parse fails. This keeps the system self-healing without external APIs.

fixes.fix: Auto-Generate 'Easy' Questions from Invented Pool
fixes.detail: The invented pool has 7 easy questions but the main bank is frozen at 1 AI item; we need to grow thin pools.
fixes.text: Create a GitHub Action step that randomly selects 2 items from the 'easy' category of the invented pool and formats them as standard HTML question blocks, appending them to the main content directory via the existing file-lane mechanism.
